abstract: Covers the European Digital Identity Wallet Architecture and Reference Framework (ARF) at release 3.0.0 and its Annex 2 High-Level Requirements: the roles (Wallet Providers and Wallet Units, PID Providers, QEAA, PuB-EAA and non-qualified EAA Providers, Relying Parties and intermediaries, Registrars, Access CAs and Providers of registration certificates), Trusted Lists and LoTEs, access and registration certificates, Wallet Instance Attestations and Key Attestations, the ISO/IEC 18013-5 mdoc and SD-JWT VC formats and the PID Rulebook identifiers, issuance with OpenID4VCI and HAIP, remote presentation with OpenID4VP or ISO/IEC 18013-7 over redirects or the W3C Digital Credentials API, ISO/IEC 18013-5 proximity presentation, User approval, revocation with status lists, embedded disclosure policies, unlinkability methods and pseudonyms, with Regulation (EU) 2024/1183 as the cited legal basis. Version lines: ARF 3.0.0 is current, ARF 2.9.0 and ARF 1.10.0 are legacy, and the main branch is tracked as a preview, with upgrade steps from 2.x and 1.x. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out the version lines, roles and trust, credentials and formats, issuance and presentation, and an HLR index.
